name: large_batch_dispatch
expression: cel.bind(jobs, request.batches.flatten(), request.enabled && request.slots > 0 && jobs.size() >= request.slots && jobs.map(j, j.id).distinct().size() == jobs.size() && jobs.sortBy(j, j.priority).slice(0, request.slots).all(j, j.ready && j.cost <= request.max_cost) && request.nodes.size() >= request.slots && lists.range(request.slots).all(i, request.nodes[i].free))
